submission.justification: Absorber-F3 at 4 mm gives the best simulated resolution at 100 GeV, 3.151%. The scan covered 2, 3, 4, 4.5, 5, 6 and 10 mm. F2 is next at 3.552% (4.5 mm), and F1 is worst at 4.907% (6 mm). CAVEAT: the residual dose rate (hard limit 20 uSv/h at 1 m after one week) could not be verified for any material, because the project documents contain no dose data. The recommendation is therefore provisional. The dose compliance of F3 must be confirmed, for example by activation calculation or a documented source, before it is adopted. If F3 fails that check, the fallback is F2 at 4.5 mm (3.552%), which is also unverified.
